mechanism.claim: At fixed four-hour decisions, a simultaneous three-bar microstate in which at least four alts print two same-sign five-minute returns followed by an opposite-sign return identifies a coordinated repricing cascade. During locally elevated BTC variation, BTC follows the new flip direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: strict common sign of the latest flipped alt returns
mechanism.why_distinct: The prior synchronized-flip relay compares half-hour majority states between broad clock blocks. HVCAFC uses only the exact last three completed five-minute return signs, requires a two-bar persistent state followed by an opposite latest bar, and counts the direction of those atomic flips. It uses no half-hour aggregation, channel, variance, skew, current BTC direction, post-entry fit, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed 24-hour realized variation ranks in the upper 35 percent against the 20 strictly prior scheduled source-valid decisions, adapting causally to local July-like volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: four-hour scheduled entries at xx:35 UTC with a sparse flip-cascade gate are absent from Gross9 primitive clocks

features.bars: exact five-minute OHLC aggregated from five consecutive bars_binance one-minute rows; all seven symbols complete, finite, positive, coherent; no imputation
features.decision_times: every calendar day at exact 00:30,04:30,08:30,12:30,16:30,20:30 UTC
features.return_sign: strict sign of each completed five-minute alt log(close/open) return; zero invalid for that alt microstate
features.cascade_gate: at least four alts have a three_bar_flip and at least four latest flip signs share one strict direction while fewer than four share the opposite direction
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC five-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over 20 prior jointly source-valid scheduled decisions, minimum 15, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent atomic three-bar cross-alt flip-cascade mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, aggregation, sign law, three-bar state, cascade breadth, local-volatility history, local-volatility gate, direction, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
